title: My Dead Grandma Called Me Last Night #shorts #horror
description: She called every night at nine. Then she died. Last night, my phone rang at nine. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

lines.text: Every night at nine, my grandmother called me.
Always the same words. Lock the doors.
Last night, at exactly nine, my phone rang.
I answered. Her voice said, lock the doors.
Then a second voice whispered, right behind her.
She can't hear you anymore. But I can.
Then someone knocked on my door.
